key_points: Cocoa market stabilization is a genuine tailwind for MDLZ margins, as cocoa has been a major cost headwind; this is the most substantive headline here.
New CPO Zakaria Dahkoun (formerly SVP of cocoa enterprise) brings deep domain expertise just as input costs normalize, suggesting improved supply chain execution ahead.
Nykredit A/S taking a position is routine institutional flow — mildly positive but not thesis-changing on its own.
The PepsiCo and Nasdaq 100 headlines are not directly about MDLZ and should be discounted for this stock's outlook.
No earnings, guidance, or regulatory catalysts are present in this news batch; the combined effect is a modest, incremental positive bias.
